programs.title: Dangerous Bestie
programs.desc: (2018) Tense thriller starring Rosslyn Luke. Happy to be reunited at first, a woman quickly realises her former best friend has sinister plans to hold her and her family hostage.

programs.title: Stolen in Her Sleep
programs.desc: (2021) Psychological thriller with Morgan Bradley. A new mother's world unravels when she suspects someone is trying to steal her baby - is it real or a dangerous figment of her sleep-deprived mind?

programs.title: The Air I Breathe
programs.desc: (2007) Crime drama with Brendan Fraser. Visions, threats, desperate measures, and high-stakes gambles intertwine in this white-knuckle thriller that never stops for breath.

programs.title: Triple Cross
programs.desc: (1967) WWII spy thriller with Christopher Plummer. Loosely based on a true story, bank robber Eddie Chapman gets entangled in spying for both sides during World War Two, becoming a triple agent.

programs.title: Big Kill
programs.desc: (2019) Modern western with Jason Patric and Danny Trejo. Two misfit gamblers on the run, a tenderfoot and a deadly preacher team up for a date with destiny in a boom town gone bust.

programs.title: House of Darkness
programs.desc: (2002) Supernatural horror with Kate Bosworth and Justin Long. A man accompanies a mysterious woman to her secluded estate, but shadowy figures make it clear he isn't welcome.
